Select canonical_smiles from compound_structures, molecule chembl_id from molecule_dictionary, and standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units from activities for assay CHEMBL1217643 only. Join activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, then to compound_structures on molregno. Filter assays by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1217643'. Keep only rows where standard_value is not null, standard_relation is not null, and standard_relation equals '='. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
